surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions during the ALD process involved the adsorption of the metalorganic precursor (MeCp)W(CO)2(NO) and ammonia plasma, leading to the formation of WNxCy films. The surface reactions were influenced by the deposition temperature, plasma power, and precursor pulse time. The growth rate saturation indicated the completion of surface reactions, and the presence of amorphous nitrogen and carbon enhanced the diffusion barrier properties by blocking Cu diffusion through grain boundaries.
intermediate_species: surface species decomposed at higher temperatures
